title: My mall world predicted my future
content: So here's a little backstory before I explain: me and both of my best friends fell out a couple of months ago (no one was at fault) and it's been really hard on me. Anyway I dream about mallworld every night and I've been dreaming about it for about a year and a bit now. However since this happened I've been having the same themes, people and scenarios in my dreams every single night. It's basically in the bar/nightclub area of the mall and I bump into my old best friends and we get along and decide to become friends again. That's what I dreamt every night until New Year's Eve me and my boyfriend had plans to go to a rave at a nightclub. We had heard that my old friends were going to be there and this made me quite nervous. BUTTT when we got there we bumped into them and everything was sooo good they seemed so happy to see me they hugged me and told me they wanted to try and be friends again. This is literally what happens in my dreams every night. Now I'm back friends with them again yayy but oh my it's so weird my dreams have been predicting future scenarios 😂
